title: Anchor Doctor diagnose must run and fix hygiene; Claude/Gemini/Grok seats all broken
body:
John 2026-07-28:

The Anchor Doctor is supposed to actually run the diagnosis when you click on diagnosis and it should both diagnose as well as fix the issues related to the Anchor hygiene. Also, the different options, grok, gemini and claude should all work (does not seem like they are working all).

Success criteria for sleep:
1. Click Diagnose (including banner→Doctor with diagnose=1): actually runs diagnosis — not shell-only / seed-only / plan-only.
2. Doctor path diagnoses AND applies fixes for Anchor hygiene issues (or proposes one-click Fix with clear apply), not read-only advice that leaves the product dirty.
3. Engine options Claude, Gemini (agy), and Grok each successfully start and complete a Doctor diagnose (and fix where applicable) session — no dead menu items, no silent fail for a family.
4. Failures surface in UI with honest reason (auth, path, driver, quota) — never a no-op click.
